Day 6 (old art) - May 2015 (age 12)

my first attempt at using colored fineliner to add some *pizzaz* to the lineart!

I actually still like doing this today!

the anatomy is wonky, but I still really like that I tried to make it monochrome and add some line weight to shaded areas (barely haha) 

be kind to your younger self, the art they created is the basis for your art today!
